
[yellow bold]-- DEPRECATION -- main.volt:1[/yellow bold]

Move `chip esp32` to volt.toml: chip = "esp32"

 [dim]1 |[/dim] chip esp32
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]     ^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: The chip declaration will move to volt.toml in a future version.[/cyan]


[red bold]-- TYPE MISMATCH -- main.volt:3[/red bold]

Variable `big` declared as `int64` but assigned `int`.

 [dim]2 |[/dim] hardware { pin led: Output = 4 }
 [dim]3 |[/dim] var big: int64 = 0
 [dim]  |[/dim] [red]    ^^^[/red]

[cyan]Hint: Change the type to `int` or convert the value with `int64(value)`.[/cyan]


[red bold]-- TYPE MISMATCH -- main.volt:5[/red bold]

Cannot use `+` between `int64` and `int`.

 [dim]4 |[/dim] task isr_task {
 [dim]5 |[/dim]     every 1ms strict { big = big + 1 }
 [dim]  |[/dim] [red]                             ^^^[/red]
